title: X--SITE LEASE - DUMONT HILL
description: Notice ID: 140L1226Q0048 This is a Sole Source Notice posted in accordance with RFO 5.201(b)(1)(i). The Bureau of Land Management (BLM) intends to enter into a sole source lease agreement with Interconnect Towers, LLC for continued use of the Dumont Hill communications site. The requirement covers land use and associated site infrastructure essential to maintaining radio coverage, employee safety, and continuity of operations supporting BLM field personnel. The Dumont Hill site is a unique, geographically strategic location with existing infrastructure that cannot be replicated elsewhere without significant cost and operational disruption. This lease is necessary to ensure uninterrupted communications capabilities required for public safety and mission-critical activities. This acquisition will be conducted under the Revolutionary FAR Overhaul commercial procedures at RFO 12.102. This action is justified under RFO 6.103-1(b), Only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements. A firm fixed price award is anticipated. The Independent Government Cost Estimate places the total value of this requirement at $49,500.00. The associated NAICS code for this requirement is 532490 Rental and Leasing of Commercial and Industrial Machinery and Equipment. The applicable PSC is X1BG Lease/Rental of Electronic and Communications Facilities. The attached sole source justification has been made available for review. No solicitation documents exist. This notice of intent is not a request for competitive quotes or offers. A determination by the Government not to compete this proposed action lies solely within the discretion of the Government. Firms believing they have the capability to provide this requirement must submit written information showing clear and convincing evidence that they can meet the Government's needs. Information received will be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct a competitive requirement. Responses must reference Notice ID 140L1226Q0048 and be sent in writing to Gabriel Lange at glange@ios.doi.gov no later than September 16, 2026, at 5:00 PM PD.
